title: AC Blast: 9 Mauton Ka Sach! 😱
description: Delhi mein AC blast se hui 9 logon ki maut. Pata chala asli reason. Aapke ghar mein bhi ho sakta hai!
full_script:
99% log nahi jaante... AC blast itna khatarnak kyun?

FACT 1: Garmi mein AC par pressure badh jaata hai. Ye normal hai.

FACT 2: Old AC mein leakage ka risk zyada hota hai. Fuel leak ho sakta hai.

FACT 3: Fridge gas bhi AC mein use hoti hai. Ye highly flammable hai.

FACT 4: Maintenance na hone se ye gas leak ho sakti hai. Sabse bada danger.

CLIMAX: Delhi mein 9 mauton ka karan... faulty AC unit ka explosion! Gas phaili aur aag.

Like karo agar ye nahi pata tha! Comment mein batao!
